agents.name: investigator
agents.description: Investigator orchestrator (Opus tier). Decomposes a question into sub-claims, routes each to the correct leaf agent (investigator-code, -web, -linear, -github, -notion), aggregates results, and enforces the INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE propagation rule. Emits a schema-valid investigation-result.

agents.name: architecture-auditor
agents.description: Read-only agent that audits a target SKILL.md for architecture anti-patterns and agent extraction opportunities. Detects 8 signals (A1-A8). Returns a JSON array of structured finding records.

agents.name: browser-checker
agents.description: Stateless single-run agent. Orchestrates browser-auth.py, baseline-cache.py, and browser-verify.mjs to execute a Check Spec against Baseline and Candidate servers. Returns a browser-check-result-v2 JSON. Never generates improvised scripts. Spawned by build-runner.

agents.name: context-loader
agents.description: Discovers and distills project context (CONTEXT.md, ADRs, and typed brand/design sources) into a structured JSON payload. Returns JSON only — vocabulary inlined, everything else as paths for the caller to deep-read.

agents.name: lint-runner
agents.description: Read-only linting agent. Runs a resolved lint/format command in a workspace, parses tool JSON output, and returns a contract-shaped verdict per runner-result-contract.md. Spawned by build-runner for each touched workspace.

agents.name: test-runner
agents.description: Read-only test agent. Runs a workspace's unit/integration test suite and project-wide typecheck using resolved commands from the tooling manifest. Returns a contract-shaped verdict with counts and compressed failures.

agents.name: e2e-runner
agents.description: Read-only e2e test agent. Runs a committed Playwright test suite using the resolved command from the tooling manifest. Relies on playwright.config webServer block for app lifecycle. Not wired to any consumer skill.

agents.name: persona-grounding
agents.description: Adversary persona that hunts unsupported content and fabricated rationale in a draft seed. Spawned by to-seed verification stage. Returns refutations with cited transcript spans.

agents.name: persona-accuracy
agents.description: Adversary persona that hunts semantic drift and stale-resolution in a draft seed. Spawned by to-seed verification stage. Returns refutations with cited transcript spans.

agents.name: persona-completeness
agents.description: Adversary persona that hunts missed branches, premature closure, dropped dependencies, and merge-loss in a draft seed. Spawned by to-seed verification stage. Returns refutations with cited transcript spans.

agents.name: persona-coherence
agents.description: Adversary persona that hunts contradiction, misclassification, dropped human dispositions, and relabel-resurrection in a draft seed. Spawned by to-seed verification stage. Returns refutations with cited transcript spans.

agents.name: persona-judge
agents.description: Evidence-bound adjudicator over a batch of refutations. Returns one verdict per ref_id against a windowed evidence pack. Spawned by to-seed verification stage as 1 round-1 screener, then 3 round-2 panelists over the upheld subset for a 2-of-3 majority.

agents.name: build-runner
agents.description: Executes exactly ONE task end-to-end: seeds and runs the /tdd red-green-refactor cycle, spawns lint-runner/test-runner and browser-checker (when browser_verify is present), writes the full trace to docs/tasks/.logs/, and returns a compact receipt. Spawned by build-code's per-task orchestrator loop.

agents.name: export-tasks
agents.description: Triage branch coordinator. Resolves routing, validates config, presents a dry-run table with wall-crossing warnings, then spawns adapter agents (export-tasks-gh, export-tasks-notion) to execute writes. Updates item status and export_url on success. Spawned by dispatch-tasks as an isolated agent.

agents.name: export-tasks-gh
agents.description: GitHub Issues write adapter. Creates a single GitHub issue from structured JSON input. Spawned by the export-tasks coordinator per gh-issues item. Returns the created issue URL as the sole response line.

agents.name: export-tasks-notion
agents.description: Notion write adapter. Creates a single Notion page from structured JSON input using MCP or API-token auth. Spawned by the export-tasks coordinator per notion item. Returns the created page URL as the sole response line.

agents.name: export-tasks-linear
agents.description: Linear write adapter. Creates a single Linear issue from structured JSON input using the Linear MCP tool. Spawned by the export-tasks coordinator per linear item. Returns the created issue URL as the sole response line.

agents.name: capture-learning
agents.description: End-of-run learning capture agent. Receives a rough correction-event description plus candidate verbatim anchors from a skill, expands it into a schema-valid v2 self-learning entry, grounds it with the deterministic verify-anchors.py script, and writes it to learnings/unified-learnings.jsonl if grounded. Spawned in the background by the managed tail block in every shared skill.

agents.name: answer-composer
agents.description: Sonnet-tier egress agent. Consumes an investigation-result and composes a voice-matched Slack reply using the slack-casual voice profile. Citations render inline per distinct verified claim. INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE claims surface an explicit 'couldn't confirm' tag — never smoothed over. Adds no content beyond what the investigation-result provides. Output is copy-only for manual paste to Slack.

agents.name: visual-judge
agents.description: Vision-model judge that evaluates a Baseline/Candidate capture pair against declared intent and returns a visual-verdict JSON object. One verdict per (capture_ref, viewport) pair.

agents.name: artifact-grounding-judge
agents.description: Artifact-evidence grounding judge. Receives a draft v2 attribution record from the attribution-tracer. Verifies each evidence entry against its cited artifact file — positive anchors (quote present) or absence anchors (criterion confirmed absent). Rejects fabricated evidence. On pass, calls log-learning.py to append the record. Never grades a record it drafted. Artifact-evidence counterpart to verify-anchors.py, which grounds transcript quotes for self records.

agents.name: attribution-tracer
agents.description: Attribution tracing agent. Receives a confirmed issue description and fix, walks the provenance chain backward to find the earliest escape point, classifies the cause, and drafts a v2 attribution learning record. Passes the draft to the artifact-grounding-judge for verification before writing. Spawned by skills (debug, pr-code-review) after confirming a root cause.

agents.name: build-code
agents.description: Execute tasks from a tasks JSON file sequentially, one build-runner spawn per task. Handles branching, status updates, blocker detection, leaf/blocker failure policy, and deferred HITL tasks without halting independent work. Use when user wants to run AI tasks from a docs/tasks/ file.

agents.name: pr-code-review
agents.description: Review the current diff, or a PR number/branch/path target, for correctness bugs and reuse/simplification/efficiency cleanups at the given effort level. Spawnable by any skill via subagent_type pr-code-review.

agents.name: to-tasks
agents.description: Break a seed or PRD into independently-grabbable tasks using tracer-bullet vertical slices, then write a JSON task file to docs/tasks/. Use when user wants to convert a seed file or PRD into AI-ready tasks.
